chapter: Philadelphia, New York and Sam Wooding in Europe
title: Bobby Lee's Cottonpickers in Philadelphia
summary: Tickets from Bobby Lee brought him and Jerry Blake to Philadelphia; Lee's band played the Cinderella Inn and Sea Girt, New Jersey.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And, now you went with Bobby Lee in Philadelphia?
But what did -- did anything happen between --

No, someone sent a couple of tickets to myself and Jerry Blake. Jerry Blake, he and I were -- Nashville, you know, together, we went to school together. He was in the band in Chicago with me. And we were in this thing together. And someone sent a couple of tickets to Chicago to come to Philadelphia. It was Bobby Lee but I don't know how he learned about the two of us. That was how we got to Philadelphia from Chicago.

Bobby Lee he was a very famous out in Philadelphia. And New Jersey. He was a pianist, he looked just like a white -- very white and he had a band called Bobby Lee's Cottonpickers. And he had -- he played at the Sea Girt Inn, in Sea Girt, New Jersey every year. That's where we worked with Bobby. The first week I played at the Cinderella Inn in Philadelphia with him.
